title: Ganesha ki Buddhi aur Mallikarjun ki Kahani
hooks: Kartikeya poori duniya ghoomne nikal gaye, par Ganesha ne bina hile race kaise jeet li?
Kya Maa-Baap ke charno mein poori duniya basi hai? Ganesha ne ye sach kar dikhaya.
Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga kaise bana? Iske peeche hai bhaiyon ki ek anokhi race.
hook_why: It creates immediate curiosity about the 'how' and uses a relatable competitive scenario between brothers.

cast.Shiva: Lord Shiva, calm divine face, meditative eyes, tiger skin attire, crescent moon in matted hair, warm gold aura, painterly style.
cast.Parvati: Goddess Parvati, graceful and serene, traditional maroon silk saree, ornate gold jewelry, divine glow, painterly style.
cast.Ganesha: Lord Ganesha, wise eyes, elephant head, yellow silk dhoti, calm posture, holding a modak, painterly style.
cast.Kartikeya: Lord Kartikeya, young athletic warrior, holding a golden spear, determined expression, traditional warrior attire, painterly style.

scenes.vo: Kartikeya poori duniya ghoomne nikal gaye, par Ganesha ne bina hile race kaise jeet li?
scenes.prompt: Cinematic split screen: Kartikeya flying fast on a peacock vs Ganesha standing calmly with a smile. Painterly style, vibrant divine colors.

scenes.vo: Mahadev aur Parvati Maa ne ek shart rakhi: jo prithvi ke chakkar pehle lagaega, wahi jeetega.
scenes.prompt: Shiva and Parvati sitting on a stone throne in Kailash, gesturing to their sons. Warm golden divine aura.

scenes.vo: Kartikeya turant apne mayur par sawar hokar tezi se nikal pade.
scenes.prompt: Lord Kartikeya flying through swirling clouds on a magnificent peacock. Action shot, golden spear glowing.

scenes.vo: Lekin Ganesha ka vahan toh ek nanha sa mooshak tha. Woh itni door kaise jaate?
scenes.prompt: Close up of Ganesha looking thoughtful, with a small mouse looking up at him. Soft focus background.

scenes.vo: Tab Ganesha ne apni buddhi lagayi aur wahin baithe apne Mata-Pita ki parikrama shuru kar di.
scenes.prompt: Ganesha walking respectfully in a circle around Shiva and Parvati. Golden light trails following his steps.

scenes.vo: Unhone kaha—Hamare shastra kehte hain ki Mata-Pita ke charno mein hi poori srishti basi hai.
scenes.prompt: Ganesha bowing with folded hands to Shiva and Parvati seated on Mount Kailash, a glowing subtle map of the universe visible beneath their feet, centered composition, 9:16 vertical, space above and below for text, no text or logos.

scenes.vo: Ganesha jeet gaye! Par jab Kartikeya laute, toh naraz hokar door Krauncha parvat par chale gaye.
scenes.prompt: Kartikeya (six-faced, holding vel spear, peacock beside him) standing angrily on Krauncha mountain peak, misty background, centered, 9:16 vertical, room for text, no text or logos.

scenes.vo: Apne bete ko manane Mahadev 'Arjun' aur Mata 'Mallika' ke roop mein wahan pahunche.
scenes.prompt: Shiva as Arjun (hunter/tribal form with bow and arrow, wearing simple leaves) and Parvati as Mallika (tribal woman with jasmine flowers in hair) standing together on a mountain, humble divine light around them, centered, 9:16 vertical, space for text, no text or logos.

scenes.vo: Isi wajah se is pavitra sthan ka naam pada—Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga.
scenes.prompt: The Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga in a sanctum, the linga adorned with a garland of white jasmine (mallika) flowers and a small golden bow (symbol of Arjun) placed beside it, divine atmosphere with soft light, centered, 9:16 vertical, space for text, no text or logos.

scenes.vo: Ye mandir Andhra Pradesh ke Srisailam mein hai, jahan aaj bhi bhakt umadte hain.
scenes.prompt: Wide shot of the majestic Mallikarjun Temple at Srisailam during golden sunset, intricate architecture visible, devotees walking, serene atmosphere, 9:16 vertical, space for text, no text or logos.

scenes.vo: Kya aapne kabhi Mallikarjun ke darshan kiye hain? Comment mein 'Har Har Mahadev' likhiye.
scenes.prompt: Clean maroon gradient background with subtle gold accents, ample empty space for text, no text in image.

caption:
Ganesha ki buddhi ya Kartikeya ki raftar? 🙏

Jaaniye Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga ki ye adbhut katha jahan Ganesha ne bataya ki Mata-Pita hi asli duniya hain.

Kya aapne kabhi Srisailam ke darshan kiye hain?
